steps.content: Morghan and Ethan crane their necks to take another look at the conspicuously unoccupied desk in the office. It used to be Bianca's cubicle, but now it's used as storage space.

steps.speaker: Ethan
steps.content: Have you heard from her?

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: No. Her dismissal was very sudden. She didn't even take the apple-themed blind boxes on her desk with her when she left. I was the one who put them away.
Morghan and Ethan exchange glances and sigh.

steps.speaker: Morghan
steps.content: On the bright side, knowing Bianca, a restless spirit to the core, maybe we'll see her on the news soon...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hmmm...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I'm a reporter, skilled and polite... I capture bad guys, left and right, and soon there will be no villains in sight!
Ahhh!
You're bone-tired when the destination is close.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Tired again? Hang in there, Chief. We're almost there. News waits for no one.
As you adjust your breathing, you glance over at Bianca. She is walking in a quick light step while humming a tune, looking as if she doesn't have a care in the world.

options: You still remember our objective, right?

choices.text: You still remember our objective, right?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Keep a low profile. Don't use abilities without permission. Don't act alone.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Sneak into the factory, uncover its dark secrets, and reveal them to the world. Wow, that sounds really cool!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Look, we've arrived. That's one of the other factories kept hidden by Cohen.
You look up at the factory ahead, its towering walls hiding the structures inside from view. You can hear the muffled sound of heavy machinery running.
You see no outlets from the outside, and every entrance is heavily guarded. The factory looks to you like an impregnable bastion.

options: How did you get in last time?

choices.text: How did you get in last time?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Easy. Look over there. Under that wall, there is a small hole, just big enough for one person to squeeze through. I found it by accident last time.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: What's the matter? You look annoyed. Relax! I was just messing with you. I'm Eastside's number one reporter. I know how to get into places.
Like what?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Under the right circumstances, the most dangerous place can be the safest place. The same logic applies to infiltration operations. As long as you know how to think outside the box, any enemy that stands in your way can be easily dealt with.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: We'll go straight in, through the main entrance!
You and Bianca are holed up in a confined space crammed with God knows what.
Moreover, the box that holds the two of you vibrates at a rhythmic pace. The box is in transit, you're sure.
Is this what you meant by going in through the main entrance?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: We're hiding in a box, and the box will be carried in through the main entrance. Technically, I wasn't wrong.
The vibration stops, and you hear the sound of a forklift. Then you feel a sudden sense of weightlessness. The transportation is over, and you're being unloaded.

steps.speaker: Puzzled Worker
steps.content: Why does today's cargo feel so much heavier than usual? Did they change the supplier?
The voice draws near. You fear that its owner is going to open the box and examine the contents, but that doesn't happen. Another voice pipes up.

steps.speaker: Trouble-averse Worker
steps.content: Leave it be! Let's hurry up and get this over with. I don't want to stay in this dump a minute longer than necessary.
After a while, you can no longer hear the two voices outside. You press your ear against the box, and the only sound is the hum of machinery.
We can get out now.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: All right, it's my turn to shine! Step back from this spot and cover your ears. Yes, yes... Be careful not to get hurt.
It's too dark to see what exactly Bianca is doing, but you seem to hear something being pressed against the inside of the box.
Bang!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hooray! Infiltration successful!
The box has been broken open. You turn to Bianca. She's holding the weapon responsible for the destruction of the box—the camera she always carries.
Do not use abilities without permission. What part of this sentence don't you understand?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hahaha... It's not like we're shooting a James Bond movie. No need to complicate things. Special times call for special measures, don't you think? Blasting it was just quick and quiet!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You angry with me again, Chief? You may have your reason, but can we just finish our investigation first?
Bianca climbs out of the box first. She holds out her hand with a grin on her face.
Fine, we'll settle the score when this is all done. You caused quite a commotion just now. Let's hurry up and complete our investigation before the patrol arrives.
The patrol won't circle back to where the two of you are for another half an hour. That should be enough time to investigate the place.

You look around. The interior of the factory has a simpler layout than you expected. Other than some massive pieces of machinery and the large boxes stacked in the corners, there isn't much else to see. Strangely, at this moment, no one is here but you and Bianca.
How come there is no one on duty here? The workers you've seen so far are either guards posted at the entrances or movers wearing thick protective clothing who never stay long inside.

As you suspected, the concentration of Mania here is not particularly high—probably because the Rust is still some distance away, and certainly not high enough to warrant the wearing of protective clothing that thick.
Why is it that they're so reluctant to linger in the workshop, even though they're adequately protected?
There must be something else hidden in the room. Bianca, let's go over there and check.
Bianca?
You turn your head to look at Bianca. She's squatting beside the box you just hid in, filming the contents.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I didn't really see what was in it when I got inside. I only knew it was something shiny. And sure enough...
When Bianca turns her head, you see that she's wearing an uncharacteristically serious expression.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: It's <color=#fb9259>guns</color>.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Semi-finished guns, to be precise. Based on what little knowledge I have of weapons, I think the ammo-loading part has been modified; these guns don't use bullets, at least not ordinary bullets.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Haha, now I see why they set up the factory in such a dangerous place. The Public Security Bureau would have a field day if they found out what they're up to.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: This is no waste treatment plant. It's an illegal factory for weapon manufacturing!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Still, that doesn't answer everything. The mysterious objects, semi-finished guns, peculiar location... The Mania concentration in the Rust area is quite high, not ideal for any arms dealer. There must be something more for them to set up business here.

options: Maybe they have other game plans.

choices.text: Maybe they have other game plans.

steps.content: Maybe they need something from the Rust? But besides Mania, there's nothing but the contaminated—
You don't finish the sentence. You and Bianca lock eyes, as realization dawns.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Let's go check the assembly line. I bet we can find evidence there.
Bianca leaps to her feet, grabs your hand, and pulls you along to a roaring piece of machinery that is busy turning a large number of semi-finished products into deadly weapons.
Bianca puts her camera to use. The glass tubes of the finished products are filled with a repulsive-looking crimson fluid. It's Mania extract.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ashy, we've struck gold.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: They're making Mania weapons!

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: Hey! Who's there?
The beam of a flashlight shoots into the workshop as a security guard walks in, a suspicious look on the face.

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: Weird. I could have sworn I heard someone talking just now. Was I mistaken?
The light beam moves between the boxes and machines. You and Bianca are wedged in a narrow nook where the light can't reach, not making a sound.
The security guard moves around. You and Bianca start mouthing messages to each other while gesturing, hoping against hope that you've known each other well enough to get the messages across.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: (Someone's coming! What do we do?)
The footsteps are getting closer, and soon the light will reach your hiding spot.
(There's no way out. If this investigation fails, they'll know that someone is onto them.)
(We must bring the evidence out.)

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: (Must what? Break it now?)
(WE MUST BRING IT OUT.)

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: (Break it out? No prob. On the count of three. One, two—)
(Wait a second, Bianca!)

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Three! Run!
Bianca grabs hold of you. The two of you dash out of the hiding spot, heading for the exit.

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: What the heck! Intruders! Close the gates! Quick!
The iron gates slowly close. You run as fast as you can, but the gates fully close before you reach them.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Won't that break the rules?
Special times call for special measures! Aim for the gates and fire!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, copy that!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Here we go, obstacles in our way! Look over here and say cheese!
You see something flash on the edge of your vision. And then a beam of intense light hits the gates and blows a hole in them.
You and Bianca bolt into the open air, shake off the pursuers, and head back to the urban area. Bianca wastes no time in posting your findings on the internet.

[Ongoing Exposure! Source of Eastside Mania, leaked video about Cohen Group factory! To be deleted in 24 hours!] 
Poster: Extra-Rich Apple Juice 2.0
Views: 20k+ Comments: 1086
Bianca immerses herself in the world of cyberspace, as if what she sent out isn't just a post, but a declaration of war on the forces of darkness in the entire DisCity.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The topic is gaining momentum. Every internet forum is talking about it now. Let's wait some more, and then we'll get the mainstream media involved; before too long, there will be an official statement denouncing this evil company, and that will be the final nail in their coffin.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hehe, what a perfect plan. I truly am the best reporter in the MBCC.
When the chilled aluminum can touches her cheek, Bianca gives a shiver, startled.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: W-what's that? W-why is it so cold? Is it made of metal? P-please don't do this. Except for that one accident, I-I've never caused serious harm to anybody. Chief, I-I don't deserve such severe punishment.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Phew, it's just apple juice.
Never thought a can of apple juice could scare you so.
Bianca, grinning, takes the proffered apple juice, pulls the tab, and raises the can to clink it against yours.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: To the great victory of good over evil, and to the upcoming full exposure of those scum. Cheers!

You take a sip of your fizzy drink. As you swallow, you feel that familiar burning sensation at the back of your throat. Not wanting to make a fool of yourself again, you drink slowly this time around.
The two of you are perched on the highest point of the main MBCC building. You can see Eastside in the distance; its illuminated areas look bright and shiny, a sharp contrast to the unlit areas.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Yahoo, apple juice sure is an invaluable treasure, a symbol of truth, the patron saint of all reporters...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Sigh... Too bad that what I truly want, I can't attain through Gray Mirror or the apple juice deity...
Bianca sits with her knees drawn up to her chest and her head down, muttering away, more a sulking child than a legendary reporter.
This may be a good opportunity to learn how she really feels inside.

options: Bianca, what do you truly want?

choices.text: Bianca, what do you truly want?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: What do I want? Hah... Too many to count.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I want to try the new flavor of apple juice in that convenience store; I want to buy the latest apple-themed blind box just released in Eastside; I want clues to come to me without me running around all day to do interviews...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I want everything to go as smoothly as I hope; I want to catch all the bad guys, to see them punished by Super Apple...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I want my reports to circulate as widely as possible. I want them not to be ignored like they used to be.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: And...

Bianca's voice becomes lower and lower until you can barely make out what she's saying. You think she might have fallen asleep again, but when you turn to look, you find that she is staring at the computer by her side, her expression serious without any hint of tipsiness.
Bianca is motionless. You lean over to take a look at the screen.
It's an official private message from the forum.

User Extra-Rich Apple Juice 2.0 has been found to be spreading misinformation on the forum. This behavior has significantly eroded productive discussion within the forum community. On account of multiple reports from other users, all content posted under this account, including replies and comments, will now be removed from this site. In addition, Extra-Rich Apple Juice 2.0 is to be permanently banned from the forum. This ban is effective immediately and is not subject to appeals.
